== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player in a floral Star Wars shirt, with receding hair and a grey goatee, is the same man as the standing floral-shirt player in [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 17.jpg]] and [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 19.jpg]]. The player in a plaid shirt, a grey cap, and a full beard is the same man as [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 55.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
The [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] in Seattle, Washington (8–10 April 2022).

* '''Event:''' [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-04-12
* '''Camera date:''' 2022-04-10
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
